response.guide: Pass id to get_option_instruments as chain_id to list contracts. CURB market_hours on place_option_order require extended_hours_state='enabled' AND an index chain (underlying_instruments empty). When the user mentions AM/PM/morning/evening expiration, check settle_on_open per chain — same underlying can have multiple chains, so do not assume they split cleanly by settlement. Present id, symbol, expiration_dates (annotate AM when settle_on_open is true), and trade_value_multiplier.
